abstract: Fungus‐resistant grapevine varieties provide an ideal tool to reduce pesticide use in wine production. We test whether providing information about the pesticide risks for human health, the environment or both affects consumers' willingness to pay (WTP) for wine from fungus‐resistant varieties. We use a discrete choice experiment combined with information treatments involving 1587 consumers in the United States and Switzerland, that is, countries with different wine markets, cultures and policies. Results show that providing information about environmental risks to US consumers increases their WTP for wine from fungus‐resistant varieties while all other treatments had no significant effect. In contrast, no information treatments affected Swiss consumers' WTP. Results from the latent class analysis show that consumers' preferences for wine are heterogenous with five clusters in Switzerland and four in the US.
journal: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
title: Consumers' Valuation of Wine With Pesticide Risk Information: Evidence From a Cross‐Country Experiment

abstract: Agritourism is widely regarded as a promising strategy for rural development in mountain areas, but its effects depend on how it is organised within specific territorial contexts. This article compares two contrasting agritourism configurations in the neighbouring Alpine provinces of South Tyrol and Trentino, where accommodation-led and gastronomy-led models have developed under different agrarian structures, tourism markets, and governance arrangements. The study adopts a mixed-methods comparative design, combining official statistics with ten expert interviews and hence perception-based data. Our analysis focuses on four dimensions of rural development: labour and employment, economic linkages, territorial identity and landscape, and resilience to seasonality and shocks. The findings show that the gastronomy-based model is consistently rated more impactful than the accommodation-based model across all four dimensions. This difference is explained not only by the type of service offered but also by the broader regional systems in which agritourism is embedded. In Trentino, gastronomy is associated with stronger local sourcing networks, greater interaction with the local community, and less perceived conflict with neighbours, while also being seen of having fewer negative impacts on farmstead appearance and rural landscapes. In South Tyrol, accommodation is associated with household labour flexibility, family continuity, and stable platform-based governance, but with more inward-facing benefits concentrated within the farmstead. Overall, the results suggest that agritourism outcomes are shaped less by model type alone than by the interaction between farm structure, demand conditions, and institutional frameworks. The article concludes that rural policy should remain territorially differentiated, supporting selective hybridisation that broadens local benefits without weakening landscape quality or local communities.
title: Accommodation vs gastronomy: How divergent agritourism models shape rural landscapes and local communities in South Tyrol and Trentino

abstract: The recultivation of abandoned cropland is critical for promoting agricultural production and achieving food security. However, the optimal utilization of abandoned cropland remains hindered by limited insights into the spatiotemporal dynamics and underlying determinants of recultivation. This study analyzed the spatial patterns of recultivated cropland in China from 2001 to 2021 based on a coupled spatiotemporal change classification framework (CSTCC), and explored their underlying drivers using a geographical detection model. The results indicated that, of the 475,715 km² of cropland that experienced abandonment, 172,112 km² (36.18%) was subsequently recultivated. Recultivation rates exhibited a sharp decline from 42.48% in plain regions to 33.60% in mountainous regions. This pattern was driven by agro-environmental conditions, policy interventions, and socio-economic factors. Agro-environmental factors were associated with the physical and economic feasibility of recultivation, particularly crop planting structure and terrain. Policy interventions may encourage recultivation by increasing demand through the cropland protection system and offering advantageous conditions for agricultural development. Such policies could stimulate recultivation even in areas with less favorable agricultural conditions. Socioeconomic factors highlighted key constraints to recultivation, such as labor availability and the low attractiveness of agricultural employment. The findings provide significant insights into global efforts to advance the Zero Hunger goal of the Sustainable Development Agenda by recultivating abandoned cropland.

abstract: This study provides the first causal evidence that internet-based financial news sentiment significantly influences firms’ access to trade credit, an informal yet economically critical financing channel. Using 34,328 firm-year observations from Chinese A-share listed firms (2007–2021), we find that positive media tone significantly increases trade credit, while negative coverage reduces it, highlighting the comparable influence of both sentiment dimensions. We provide evidence consistent with two channels—information asymmetry and corporate governance—through which media sentiment shapes supplier credit decisions. We further show that the informational role of internet media tone varies across ownership structures spanning information providers (media outlets), financing recipients (buyers), and financing providers (suppliers). While media tone remains informative across media ownership types, its association with trade credit is stronger for non-state-owned media outlets. Consistent with this pattern, the effect is weaker for state-owned enterprises, firms with a higher proportion of state-owned suppliers, large firms, and those with high institutional ownership, but stronger in reputationally sensitive “sin” industries and during periods of low investor sentiment. Exploiting the 2014 21st Century Business Herald scandal as a quasi-natural experiment, our identification strategies support a causal interpretation.

abstract: Education is widely viewed as a driver of agricultural productivity, yet its association with technology gaps and farming efficiency remains ambiguous. Ghana provides a revealing case, where major educational reforms have coincided with persistent yield gaps. Using nationally representative data from 19,862 households in the sixth and seventh rounds of the Ghana Living Standards Survey, we apply a stochastic metafrontier framework combined with Euclidean distance matching to assess how farmer education is associated with estimated technology gaps (TGRs) and technical efficiency. Our results show that farmer education is associated with higher managerial capacity and larger estimated TGRs. Educated farmers record higher technical efficiency (0.799 vs. 0.606 for uneducated peers), but they also face a 10% points estimated technology gap. When disaggregated, receiving some formal education and training, being literate and numerate and current school enrolment are all associated with significant efficiency gains. Other education measures are either not statistically significant or are negatively associated with efficiency, underscoring the heterogeneous relationship between education and farm performance. These findings point to the possible value of combining education with measures that ease potential technological constraints. Sector‐specific training and targeted incentives may be relevant to technological endowment and sustained productivity growth.
title: Heterogeneous Farmer Education, Technology Gaps, and Technical Efficiency in Ghana

abstract: Proxy SVARs often rely on a single credible proxy, leaving proxy exogeneity untestable. Narrative arguments used to justify proxy validity imply a stronger form of exogeneity. We formalize the strong exogeneity assumption and propose a corresponding test based on internal synthetic proxies. The approach uses the external proxy to locate the target-shock direction in the reduced-form innovations and synthesize the candidate shock into an additional internal synthetic proxies, which allows to test the joint exogeneity of the original and internal synthetic proxy. We derive the large-sample theory for the ISP test and show that the identification strength is governed by a direct measure of the target shock’s non-Gaussianity. We study weak identification under asymptotic Gaussianity and develop an identification-robust version of the test. Monte Carlo experiments demonstrate the favorable power of the test when the proxy has a low signal-to-noise ratio. Applications to monetary policy and oil supply news shocks find no evidence against the exogeneity of the benchmark proxies.
title: Testing strong exogeneity in proxy SVARs with internal synthetic proxies

abstract: Collusion is a complex phenomenon in which companies secretly collaborate to engage in fraudulent practices. This paper presents an innovative methodology for detecting and predicting collusion patterns in different national markets using neural networks (NNs) and graph neural networks (GNNs). GNNs are particularly well suited to this task because they can exploit the inherent network structures present in collusion and many other economic problems. We develop and train models on individual market datasets from Japan, the United States, two regions in Switzerland, Italy, and Brazil, focusing on predicting collusion in single markets. In our empirical study, GNNs generally outperform NNs in detecting collusive patterns, although their performance relative to a recent CNN-based detection approach varies across datasets. This research contributes to the ongoing discourse on preventing collusion and optimizing detection methodologies, providing valuable guidance on the use of NNs and GNNs in economic applications to enhance market fairness and economic welfare.
title: Collusion Detection with Graph Neural Networks

abstract: We introduce an aggregation approach for network games with linear best replies, which replaces a group of players with identical outside neighbors—called a module—with a representative player. First, we show that the Nash aggregate game, played on the Nash quotient network induced by the modular units—maximal modules with a unique Nash equilibrium—and by pruning inactive players, provides the coarsest description of strategic interactions that yields the same Nash equilibria as the original network game. In particular, the actions of players in a modular unit in the network game are identical to their actions in the modular unit game up to a scalar, partially extending the independence of Nash equilibria of connected components. Next, we demonstrate that our aggregation approach is particularly relevant for cograph games, which are played on networks without induced paths of length four, such as nested split graphs. Notably, we show that stable equilibria correspond to maximal independent sets of the Nash quotient network, and we present an algorithm to compute and rank all equilibria according to various objectives, including aggregate play and the number of active players.
title: Aggregation in networks

abstract: We consider priority-based allocation and regard priorities as transferable property rights. A mechanism is priority-swapping-proof if no pair of agents can both strictly gain from swapping their priorities. We show that the deferred acceptance algorithm is priority-swapping-proof if and only if the initial priorities satisfy the acyclicity condition of Ergin (2002). Moreover, within acyclic priorities, deferred acceptance is the unique stable and priority-swapping-proof mechanism. In establishing this result, we provide a characterization of the set of stable allocations under acyclicity, which shows that every stable allocation can be obtained from the agent-pessimal one through a structured sequence of pairwise exchanges.
title: Priority-swapping-proof allocation

abstract: This paper develops a tractable model of a two-tier monetary system with heterogeneous banks and incomplete markets. In the model, banks have a dual role as loan providers and money creators, and cannot fully diversify credit risk. Central bank reserves are used to settle interbank claims and serve as a safe asset, thereby buffering risks for banks. The model characterizes bank-lending dynamics under general fiscal and monetary policy. Within the specified policy class, we derive the welfare-optimal reserve-to-GDP ratio and the interest rate on reserves consistent with its implementation and a given inflation target. We identify new dynamic risk channels of monetary policy linking banks’ exposure to uninsurable risk, relative wealth, and lending dynamics. In the competitive-deposit-market benchmark, every interior stationary allocation is a saddle under constant taxes, including the welfare-optimal allocation. A lack of coordination between fiscal policy and monetary policy may cause significant instability.

abstract: We build a general equilibrium model of endogenous communication, quality control, and trade. The model yields a structural gravity equation in which exogenous communication costs raise the probability of product failure and reduce trade more for products with a lower elasticity of substitution. We treat direct flight connectedness as a key determinant of communication costs and estimate its causal effect on trade using an instrument based on the discontinuity of direct flights at around 6000 miles created by air travel regulations. Novel data on international business lawsuits show that air connectedness lowers the probability of product failure. Combining the estimates with the model, we quantify the aggregate impact of air connectedness in three episodes: the long-run improvement in air connectedness, the disruption of international travel during the COVID-19 pandemic, and the closure of Russian and Ukrainian airspace after the outbreak of the war in Ukraine.
title: Communication costs, direct flights and international trade

abstract: We use 25 years of tax records for the Norwegian population to study the mobility of wealth over most of people’s working lives. We find considerable wealth mobility over the life cycle — exceeding income mobility. To understand the underlying mobility patterns, we group individuals with similar wealth histories using agglomerative hierarchical clustering, a tool from statistical learning. The mobility patterns we elicit provide evidence of segmented mobility. Over 60 percent of the population remain at the top or bottom of the wealth distribution throughout their working lives. Mobility is driven by the remaining 40 percent, who move only within the middle of the distribution. We show that parental wealth is the key predictor of who is persistently rich or poor, while human capital is the main predictor of those who rise and fall through the middle of the distribution. Highly-educated individuals drive upward mobility by converting high labor incomes into property wealth early in life and into financial assets afterwards. Downward mobility is primarily driven by declining or stalling business wealth.
title: The life-cycle dynamics of wealth mobility

abstract: We study how institutional constraints on executive selection shape redistributive policy, using a 1919 Danish reform that transferred mayoral selection to town councils. Although the reform applied uniformly, it made left-wing executive control feasible, especially where prior Social Democratic support was strong. Using the 1917 Social Democratic vote share interacted with an indicator for 1917 onward, we estimate the causal effect of Social Democratic mayoral rule on local public finance. Social Democratic rule increased social spending, particularly poor relief and public assistance, financed mainly through higher direct taxes. We find no robust evidence of adverse effects on measured local economic activity.
title: Left in charge: Political rule and the rise of local welfare

abstract: This study investigates whether collateral-based monetary easing is transmitted along supply chains via trade credit or is distorted by institutional frictions. Exploiting the People's Bank of China's collateral reform as a quasi-natural experiment within a financial system characterized by structural frictions like credit rationing, we find that while the policy injects low-cost liquidity into treated firms via the commercial bank intermediary layer, these privileged firms significantly reduce their trade credit provision. The reform alters firms' marginal funding constraints: the availability of cheap capital activates arbitrage incentives, particularly among eligible firms with low core-business returns, thereby crowding out funds previously allocated to supply chain financing. Severe financing frictions amplify this crowding-out effect, whereas robust corporate governance mitigates it. Ultimately, when policy transmission relies on an intermediary layer amidst credit discrimination, monetary easing can fundamentally alter firms' micro-decision logic. Consequently, such policies may inadvertently fuel financial arbitrage rather than cascade to downstream firms, underscoring the critical need to monitor liquidity flows within production networks.

abstract: We present experimental evidence from Kenya on the effects of educational television on children’s literacy, socio-emotional skills, and gender attitudes. Using a pre-registered encouragement design with 4373 primary school children, we evaluate the impact of Nuzo & Namia, a literacy-focused television show broadcast free over the air. We find strong evidence the show increased self-reported curiosity by 12% of a standard deviation and suggestive evidence it increased comprehension by 9% of a standard deviation, with no significant effects in other literacy skills. These gains are concentrated among children from English-speaking households, suggesting the English-language broadcast may exacerbate existing gaps. We also find suggestive evidence the show reinforced traditional gender attitudes. Evidence on mechanisms suggests effects are driven by its informational content rather than by changes in overall television consumption, preferences, or parental investment. Taken together, the findings highlight the promise and the limits of educational television as a scalable intervention.
title: Learning through living room screens: Experimental evidence from Kenya

abstract: We introduce a novel equilibrium concept that combines the cursed equilibrium (Eyster and Rabin, 2005) with Knightian uncertainty. This concept is then applied to a two-player game in which agents can engage in trade or refuse to do so. While the Bayesian Nash equilibrium predicts that trade never happens, players do trade in a cursed equilibrium. When Knightian uncertainty is added and agents are uncertainty averse, nothing changes in the uncursed equilibrium. If players are cursed, they are willing to trade even more. This contrasts general findings that uncertainty reduces trade but is consistent with behavior that has been observed in experiments.
title: Cursed Equilibria and Knightian Uncertainty in a Trading Game

abstract: The growing complexity of land use policy making (LUPM) has increased interest in technologies that may support planning-related analysis and decision processes. In this context, generative artificial intelligence (AI) is attracting increasing attention, yet the conditions that may facilitate its adoption remain insufficiently understood. To address this gap, this study combines the technology-organization-environment (TOE) framework with a hybrid T-spherical fuzzy weighted influence nonlinear gauge system (WINGS) interpretive structural modeling (ISM) approach to identify and analyze the drivers associated with generative AI adoption. In this framework, the drivers of generative AI adoption are explored using the TOE framework. Furthermore, the T-spherical fuzzy WINGS-ISM approach is applied to generate the structure and interrelationships of the drivers, a weighted influence nonlinear gauge system method, and interpretive structural modeling. The T-spherical fuzzy set interactive weighted Heronian mean operator, constructed based on the interactive operational laws, can effectively capture interactions among expert evaluations. Subsequently, a numerical example is presented to identify the drivers of the TOE framework that may support the adoption of generative artificial intelligence in LUPM. The results show that, among the factors identified in this study, Leadership and vision ( D s O 2 ), Output reliability ( D s T 2 ), and Stakeholder support ( D s E 4 ) are the most influential drivers. The drivers are structured across four hierarchical levels, with Inter-sector collaboration ( D s O 4 ) located at the deepest level, indicating the foundational role in influencing the other drivers. The findings provide a quantitative assessment of expert judgments from multiple domains, offering an expert-informed analytical framework for understanding the drivers associated with generative AI adoption in LUPM.
title: Mapping the drivers of generative AI adoption in land use policy making: A T-spherical fuzzy WINGS-ISM analysis

abstract: Africa’s historical borderlands are persistently associated with low levels of economic development. This paper examines how these regions respond to development interventions, analysing whether the long-run development advantage associated with colonial Christian missions persists near historical homeland borders. Combining georeferenced data on 3365 pioneering mission stations with high-resolution satellite night-time luminosity data, we show that the positive association between proximity to missionary activity and contemporary economic development weakens sharply in these borderland areas. This result is robust across a wide range of specifications and is corroborated by evidence on household wealth and human capital from the Demographic and Health Surveys Program. Our findings suggest that the success of development initiatives in the historical borderlands reflects not only the interventions themselves, but also the institutional environments in which they were implemented.
title: Development interventions in Africa’s historical borderlands: Evidence from colonial missions

abstract: Whether the effects of structural monetary policy extend beyond targeted firms through interfirm credit relationships and reshape the customer credit risk borne by these firms remains insufficiently understood. We exploit the introduction of China’s Technology Innovation Relending Facility in 2022 and estimate a difference-in-differences model using Chinese A-share firms listed in Shanghai and Shenzhen over 2016 to 2024. The results show that the policy significantly increases customer credit risk among eligible firms. Mechanism tests indicate that the policy lowers debt financing costs and improves debt maturity structures. The resulting improvement in financing conditions further alters customer credit allocation, as reflected in faster overall receivables collection alongside a higher share of long-overdue receivables in firms’ credit portfolios. These effects are stronger for firms facing greater financing frictions and those with higher pre-policy customer credit risk. Further analysis shows that future actual write-offs increase significantly following the policy, current allowances for doubtful accounts predict subsequent write-offs, and the results exhibit no evident pattern of earnings management. Overall, the findings reveal how structural monetary policy is transmitted from bank financing to interfirm credit relationships and provide new evidence on the risk-allocation consequences of targeted financial support.

abstract: In this paper, we study a many-to-one matching market where ties in the preferences of agents are allowed. In this setting, there exist three ways in which a pair of agents blocks a matching, i.e., a strongly blocking pair, a weakly blocking pair, and a super weakly blocking pair. In this paper, we generalize this setting to one where partner sets satisfy general matroid constraints rather than capacity constraints, and examine the relation between the set of stable matchings and the core with respect to each of the three ways in which a pair of agents blocks a matching.
title: The set of stable matchings and the core in a matching market with ties and matroid constraints

abstract: Climate-induced shocks can propagate from firms’ balance sheets to the banking sector, raising open questions about how adaptation strategies interact with financial stability. To answer these questions, we develop a Stock-Flow-Consistent Agent-Based Integrated Assessment Model with a financial accelerator, calibrated on U.S. data, to examine the macro-financial effects of homogeneous and heterogeneous climate shocks to labor and capital productivity. Damage heterogeneity amplifies GDP losses through the financial accelerator: concentrated shocks erode firms’ financial soundness, raising leverage and default rates and tightening economy-wide credit conditions. Adaptation strategies can partially mitigate these effects, but their effectiveness depends critically on damage type and distribution. Central bank adaptation redistributes climate impacts from firms to banks, compressing interest margins and ultimately worsening credit rationing. Firm-level adaptation preserves productive capacity but proves incentive-incompatible under labor shocks, as higher production costs lead firms to revise targets downward. Across all scenarios, smaller firms remain disproportionately exposed, calling for integrated policy frameworks combining fiscal policy, insurance mechanisms, and climate-sensitive monetary tools.
title: Adaptation to climate-induced macrofinancial risks: Top-down and bottom-up solutions

abstract: Mental health problems among adolescents have become a growing public health concern, yet the role of peer-induced educational competition as a determinant remains poorly understood. Exploiting the random assignment of classmates in a large, nationally representative dataset from China, a setting characterized by exceptionally intense academic competition and widespread private tutoring, we find that higher peer spending on private tutoring significantly worsens students’ mental health. The effect operates through intensified academic competition, which prolongs study hours, reduces sleep and leisure time, and heightens classroom tension. The adverse impacts are concentrated among boys, left-behind children, and students from less affluent families. We find no corresponding improvement in academic performance, suggesting that competitive tutoring investments generate psychological costs without commensurate academic benefits. These findings uncover an unintended spillover cost of shadow education in highly competitive educational systems and carry important implications for policies related to private tutoring and adolescent mental health.

abstract: This study estimates carbon emissions for 362 Chinese cities from 2012 to 2022 using NPP-VIIRS night-time light data, systematically analysing their spatiotemporal patterns and underlying drivers. Results indicate: (1) China’s total urban carbon emissions show a fluctuating rise, with a west-low east-high spatial pattern. Medium-carbon emission areas account for the highest proportion, at 36.7%, and among high-carbon emission areas, nearly 75% are cities in the eastern region. (2) Carbon emissions show clear spatial clustering: high-high clusters in industrial eastern regions, low-low in underdeveloped western areas. The clustering dynamics exhibit a core-periphery migration pattern, with hotspots shifting from the eastern coast to the middle reaches of the Yangtze River. (3) The centroid of carbon emissions shifted westward from Zhumadian to Nanyang over 11 years, with a cumulative migration distance of 192.7 km, while the standard deviational ellipse expanded in the northeast-southwest direction. (4) The mitigating effects of economic development, financialization, and industrial upgrading on carbon emissions weakened annually with spatial gradients; technological innovation, digital economy, FDI, and green finance exhibited strengthened emission-reduction impacts, particularly in central and western regions. Environmental regulation initially suppressed emissions but later contributed to rebound effects, while infrastructure’s mitigation role varied regionally.

abstract: This paper investigates the impact of COVID‐19‐related restrictions on domestic violence in Italy, distinguishing between formal restrictions ( de jure ) and actual behavioural responses ( de facto mobility reduction). We assess how de jure and de facto lockdowns affected domestic violence incidence using a novel identification strategy that leverages the Oxford COVID‐19 Government Response Tracker's Stringency Index and reductions in traffic‐related air pollutants. Domestic violence is measured using three complementary indicators: police reports for mistreatment and stalking, helpline calls, and Google Trends searches for domestic‐violence‐related terms. Fixed effects panel regressions, including dynamic lag structures and time‐varying covariates, reveal that domestic violence increased significantly following restrictions. Crucially, the strongest effects occurred not immediately after the formal lockdown announcements, but with a time delay, coinciding with actual mobility reductions. These time‐sensitive effects are consistent with the exposure theory, and support the relevance of the relative power in intimate relationships. Findings highlight the importance of anticipatory policy design: support services and interventions must be deployed promptly to mitigate the rising risk of domestic violence during periods of forced cohabitation and social constraint.

abstract: Utilizing the information on the digital services provided Alipay, one of the world’s biggest BigTech companies, this paper constructs a new measure of the development level of the regional digital infrastructure (hereafter RDI) at the city level in China. Using the RDI, we empirically examine the impact of regional digital infrastructure development on cross-regional merger and acquisition activities (M&As) in a sample of Chinese cities from 2011 to 2020. We document that higher levels of digital infrastructure development in acquirer (and target) regions enhance both the likelihood and volume of cross-regional M&As. These conclusions remain robust to a series of tests, including IV regression, alternative model settings and samples. Mechanism analysis indicates that the facilitating effect of digital infrastructure is stronger when geographic and institutional distances are larger, a pattern consistent with digital infrastructure promoting cross-regional M&As by reducing information search costs and lowering monitoring costs. Moreover, the facilitating effect of digital infrastructure is more pronounced when there are greater differences between acquirer and target cities in economic growth, population density, and financial development.

abstract: US exports of liquefied natural gas have surged over the past decade and are projected to more than double again by 2030 as more capacity is built. This has raised concerns about upward pressure on domestic energy prices as well as increased methane emissions from expanded oil and gas production. The magnitude of potential increases in natural gas prices depends on how much US supply is anticipated to respond, and impacts on methane emissions will depend on which oil and gas basins that supply will come from because methane leak rates vary dramatically across basins. Using a dataset on more than 1 million US oil and gas wells, I model the spatially heterogeneous supply responses to US export demand for both US natural gas and crude oil to estimate the impacts on domestic energy prices and the effective methane leak rates of marginal supply. Gas export demand mostly spurs marginal gas supply from Appalachia where methane leak rates are low, yielding effective methane leak rates more than 40% below the national average. Oil export demand mostly spurs production from the Permian Basin with effective leak rates nearly 3 times the national average. A gas export demand shock equivalent to roughly 1% of US supply drives larger gas price effects (+2.4% per billion cubic feet/day) than estimated in other studies, while oil export demand of similar magnitude has smaller impacts on oil prices (+0.9% per 100k barrels/day).

abstract: 优化算力资源的跨区域配置，有助于提高数据利用效率、推进全国一体化算力网建设。本文构建包含数据要素、电力和算力跨区域配置的一般均衡模型，刻画“东数西算”工程通过促进东部算力需求与西部能源、气候等资源禀赋的空间匹配，推动算力跨区域配置，并量化评估其福利效应。研究发现，跨区域算力调度成本下降带来的算力调用条件改善，推动算力生产向西部集聚，致使东部福利先降后升，西部福利持续改善，总体福利持续提高，区域相对福利差距先缩小，后略有扩大。这表明，“东数西算”工程在改善总体福利的同时，也会改变区域福利的分配格局。反事实分析表明，算电协同政策能够进一步放大“东数西算”工程的总体福利效应，但不同政策的区域受益格局存在明显差异。其中，提高西部算力中心用电效率和降低电力跨区域传输成本更有利于改善西部的福利，从而缩小区域福利差距；提高西部电力供给效率虽使两地区共同受益，但东部福利增幅更大，反而扩大区域福利差距。本文为理解“东数西算”工程的福利效应提供了量化依据，并进一步揭示了算力跨区域配置在提升总体福利的同时，也会带来不同的区域分配效应。

abstract: 本文扩展生产函数模型，从双向支撑、互补性与短板约束视角分析实数融合的经济效应，构建“PCA+双向SFA”框架测度企业实数融合水平。基于中国A股上市公司数据发现：实数融合显著提高企业全要素生产率；数字经济通过缓解融资约束、提升运营效率带动实体经济，实体经济通过增强技术吸收与创新转化能力、促进数字知识积累支撑数字经济。实数融合还能改善成本控制与盈利能力，提升长期市场价值并促进新质生产力发展。数字技术基础和技术吸收基础较弱的企业边际改善更大，经营转化能力较强的企业更能将融合优势转化为生产率提升。本文构建了实数融合的理论与测度框架，揭示了数字技术投入转化为生产率提升的条件，为实体经济优化资源配置、提升融合质量提供了经验证据。

abstract: 改善数字营商环境是我国“稳外资”的关键，数据跨境治理又是决定数字营商环境的关键。近年来，在中央政府授权下，我国地方政府以捍卫安全底线为前提，围绕“促进数据跨境更便捷高效”进行了一系列治理尝试。本文从“基建治理”“监管治理”和“产业治理”维度全面捕捉地方实施的数据跨境治理关键举措并构建评价指标体系，针对2012—2024年我国269个城市的数据跨境治理水平对当地服务业FDI流入的影响展开实证研究。研究发现，地方数据跨境治理能通过成本削减、创新激励和产业集聚促进服务业FDI流入。该效应对于生产性服务业和小微型服务业FDI流入更为显著；在大型城市以及交通枢纽城市作用更为突出；更能促进服务业FDI以“合资”模式流入；“基建治理”维度的促进效应最为显著。另外，地方数据跨境治理不仅对数据密集型服务业FDI流入促进作用更强，还具有就业岗位创造等作用，但也存在使服务业FDI来源地更趋集中的风险。该结论意味着：我国需高度统筹数据跨境和稳外资工作，要注重从提升数据跨境治理水平的视角来吸引和留住FDI，不仅应基于数据跨境治理引资效应的异质性调整关键服务部门外资“准入”与“准营”政策的协同性，还需从提升外资来源多元化方面出台配套制度安排。

abstract: 本文从生产网络变迁视角提出支出口径和增加值口径消费结构之间内在关系的理论解释，其关键机制是决定消费结构的支出口径和增加值口径消费偏好通过生产网络形成了映射关系。这意味着在中国生产网络变迁背景下，如果支出口径消费偏好是稳定的，那么就不存在稳定的增加值口径消费偏好，以此评估中国消费结构转型动因就是有偏误的，因此应使用纳入可变生产网络的量化框架。应用到1995—2023年中国消费结构转型过程，研究发现：收入效应对名义消费结构转型的作用更为显著，但其边际影响逐步递减，使名义消费结构趋于稳定；价格效应对实际消费结构转型的作用也很重要，且其边际影响并未递减，使实际消费结构仍在快速转型。生产网络变迁也是推动增加值口径消费结构转型的重要因素，在支出口径消费偏好稳定时，直接使用增加值口径测度结构转型的普遍做法难以准确量化中国消费结构转型动因，基本会高估收入效应、价格效应和居民福利提升幅度。城乡居民收入差距演化是城乡居民消费结构差别缩小的重要拉动力，但对总体经济消费结构转型作用相对有限。

abstract: 随着全球科技竞争加剧，技术封锁已成为影响国际分工和产业链供应链安全的重要外部冲击。本文构建全球内生生产网络一般均衡模型，将行政性技术限制刻画为关键中间投入品的贸易价格楔子，分析其形成、传导及政策应对。结果表明，技术封锁通过提高受限投入品使用成本，使企业内生调整投入关系并同时导致生产率下降和产业链断裂。生产率效应主要经供给侧价格渠道向下游传导并影响实际GDP，产业链断裂效应则经中间品需求侧数量渠道向上游传导并影响实际产出。基于全球投入产出数据的数值模拟量化了上述机制在现实生产网络中的传导特征，并显示出明显的网络扩散和异质性。政策模拟表明，创新政策更有利于实际GDP和TFP恢复，扭曲纠正政策更有利于实际产出和受冲击行业恢复，两类政策应根据不同恢复目标合理组合。

abstract: 区域协调发展是中国式现代化的内在要求。在深入实施区域协调发展战略的进程中，地方政府因区域竞争而形成的“搭便车”“竞次赛”等行为，是重要的体制性障碍。本文构建两地区竞争模型，探讨跨区域外部性何以导致地方政府出现投资不足或投资过度问题，进而分析数据要素及全国一体化数据市场建设对地方政府投资策略的重塑作用。研究表明，数据要素凭借其非竞争性与衍生性，依托一体化数据市场的配置机制，可实现地方政府投资行为外部性的内部化。这一“内部化效应”有助于矫正区域竞争中因属地利益而产生的行为扭曲，驱动区域经济向统筹决策视角下的最优基准收敛。比较静态分析进一步表明，数字经济企业生产率的提升与一体化数据市场建设具有重要协同关系。本文的研究发现为一体化数据市场建设、区域协调发展等政策议题提供了参考依据。

abstract: 建设全国统一的劳动力大市场对于畅通国内大循环和应对人口结构变革具有重要意义。本文基于“市际分界线”的自然实验，利用2011—2019年的区县级与城市级数据，实证考察了数字经济对中国劳动力市场市际分割的影响。研究发现，中国劳动力市场的市际分割主要由非制度性因素驱动。且在样本期内，劳动力市场的非制度性分割明显减弱，而制度性分割却变化不大。进一步分析表明，数字经济的发展显著削弱了劳动力市场的市际分割。细分来看，数字经济显著弱化了非制度性分割，但对制度性分割的影响并不明显。机制检验证实，数字经济能够通过提高信息透明度和流动便捷性来削弱劳动力市场的非制度性分割。此外，数字经济的劳动力市场统一效应还呈现边际效益递减的趋势。异质性分析发现，对于要素市场化程度中等和中部地区的城市而言，数字经济有效削弱了劳动力市场的非制度性分割，但这一效应对于要素市场化程度较高或较低以及东西部地区的城市并不显著。本研究从数字经济的视角出发，为中国建设全国统一的劳动力大市场提供了理论与实践参考。

abstract: 减税对我国经济高质量发展和中国式现代化发挥了重要作用，新时代的积极财政政策应继续利用好减税这一政策工具。面对扩大内需和激励企业创新发展等多重发展目标，我国的宏观调控须重视减税方式选择，关注减税可能带来的企业劳动收入份额下降。本文基于我国减税政策实践的研究表明，税基型减税与税率型减税都会导致劳动收入份额下降，但程度存在显著差异。在相同减税力度下，税基型减税造成劳动收入份额下降的程度显著小于税率型减税。导致这种差异化影响的机制是，两种减税方式产生的一般均衡效应存在差异，其中，税基型减税通过一般均衡效应使得低劳动收入份额企业对高劳动收入份额企业的挤出效应更小。本文研究发现对增强宏观政策取向一致性具有现实意义。面对激烈的国际竞争和国内转型升级需要，既要继续运用好已有面向企业的减税政策，也要充分考虑减税对劳动收入份额的影响，在相同减税力度下更多选择税基型减税，以实现积极财政政策更好发力提效。

abstract: 中国传统生育观念中蕴含着子女应赡养父母的社会规范，可以缓解父母与子女之间的代际承诺问题，对维持社会生育水平具有正向作用。本文构建的包含内生代际转移与子女产权界定的生育理论模型，刻画了传统生育观念对子女赡养义务的约束，分析了代际承诺如何影响人们的差异化生育行为。研究发现，代际承诺的弱化会抑制低人力资本家庭的生育率,而需求侧生育政策会提升低人力资本家庭的生育率，同时缩小家庭间的子代人力资本差距，避免社会两极分化。本文研究还发现，需求侧生育政策，包括与子女数量挂钩的公共代际转移、赡养支出的税收扣除、子女随迁的教育政策、代际近居的税收减免等措施具有缓解代际承诺弱化的作用。因此，鼓励生育应从需求侧政策与供给侧政策的互补性着手，重点支持低人力资本家庭，畅通其后代向上流动的通道，在避免社会两极分化的背景下，推动适度生育水平的实现。

abstract: The proposed dissolution of Weil, Gotshal & Manges followed an exodus of prominent partners from one of America’s largest law firms. Its rapid decline illustrates how departures by key employees can encourage others to leave, even when a firm remains profitable. This column explains why such departures can become self-reinforcing and how firms can mitigate the problem through compensation design. Deferred fixed pay, dilutable compensation, and different compensation structures across employees can help firms retain skilled teams at lower cost.
title: Worker runs: How compensation design can curb contagious departures like that at Weil, Gotschal & Manges

abstract: Central banks use the interest rate paid on reserves as their key monetary policy instrument. This column argues that monetary policy creates an important cycle in banks’ profitability. Since 2021, return on equity and net interest income in euro area banks have increased, following higher interest rates and the previous quantitative easing programme. The counterpart to this development is large losses at central banks and a burden on taxpayers in the Eurosystem. To deal with this, it suggests central banks increase the unremunerated minimum reserves or to consider a tax on banks’ excess profits.
title: The return of inflation: More bank profits, more central bank losses

abstract: “高水平科技自立自强”和“现代化产业体系”是构建中国经济学自主知识体系的标识性概念，也是习近平经济思想理论体系中重要的科学范畴。高水平科技自立自强能够通过自主技术供给、转型升级驱动、产业生态构建、产业安全保障、本土市场主导和创新人才支撑等作用机制驱动现代化产业体系建设；在经济高质量发展实践中，高水平科技自立自强能够通过提升产业体系的完整性、先进性和安全性加快产业体系现代化进程，通过推动产业体系智能化、绿色化和融合化提升现代化产业体系的发展水平和国际竞争力。以高水平科技自立自强引领和驱动现代化产业体系建设的政策重点是树立服务国家战略的体系化发展理念、超前谋划科技创新和产业布局，加快新型基础设施建设、推动应用融合与场景赋能，强化新型要素引领和支撑、培育和发展新质生产力，夯实基础研究的源头自主供给、推动关键核心技术突破，深化科技体制机制改革、构建和优化科技和产业的创新生态。

abstract: 在中美科技博弈与全球保护主义加剧的背景下，中国面临日益严峻的技术脱钩压力与创新挑战。随着研发门槛持续上升，高技术研发越来越依赖于在该领域中拥有卓越实力的领军企业。本文以超级明星创新企业为切入点，发现中国的专利集中度呈现与美国不同的“先上升、后下降”的动态变化，揭示了中国技术崛起中的一系列典型事实，由此构建了一个后发国家技术赶超中企业创新行为的动态均衡模型。研究发现，当后发国家的超级明星创新企业实现技术赶超后，将通过打破先发国家企业的市场垄断并释放创新激励，驱使非明星创新企业加大研发投入和创新力度，最终推动后发国家整体实现技术崛起与经济增长。多情境数值模拟表明，对于后发国家而言，定向研发补贴和降低研发要素成本均能推动实现技术赶超，而知识溢出效应发挥着关键性的作用。结合中美两国的对比分析发现，持续增强的知识溢出效应、广延边际的产业创新投资，与超级明星创新企业的技术赶超共同驱动了中国专利集中度的演变与技术崛起。中国的创新驱动发展已进入加快培育超级明星创新企业的阶段，这为我国科技领军企业的定位和布局提供了重要经验证据和理论支撑。

abstract: The Sustainable Development Goals call for women’s full and effective participation in decision-making, yet tools to measure women’s empowerment within policy processes remain limited. This paper develops the Women’s Empowerment in Agrifood Governance (WEAGov) framework—nine indicators, 38 measures, and a scoring method that assess whether women are considered, included, and influential at the design, implementation, and evaluation stages of the agrifood policy cycle—and applies it in India and Nigeria. The pilots combine content analysis of 49 agrifood policies with surveys of 274 public, private, civil society, and research organizations and 407 policy experts. In both countries, gender priorities articulated in policy documents weaken during budgeting, implementation, and evaluation. Women participate as staff and mid-level managers in agrifood organizations, but their representation in senior decision-making roles and their influence over policy decisions remain limited, constrained by social norms and limited awareness of policies and rights. Gender-responsive budgeting is absent in Nigeria and, in India, has become a procedural exercise rather than a driver of resource allocation. The two countries face different bottlenecks: India’s main challenge is converting formal gender commitments into women’s influence within state institutions, whereas Nigeria’s is translating women’s influence through civil society into formal commitments and inclusion mechanisms. Triangulating document reviews with expert assessments exposes gaps between formal commitments and practice that conventional indicators miss. We identify a core set of measures and minimum sampling requirements for rapid, low-cost applications, offering governments, researchers, and civil society a tool to diagnose and monitor gender gaps in agrifood policy processes.
title: Are agrifood policy processes Empowering Women? framework, measurement, and empirical evidence from India and Nigeria

abstract: Multivariate linear regression and randomization‐based inference are two essential methods in statistics and econometrics. Nevertheless, the problem of producing a randomized test for the value of a single regression coefficient that is exactly valid when errors are exchangeable, and which is asymptotically valid for the best linear predictor, has remained elusive. In this paper, we produce a test that is exactly valid with exchangeable errors and which allows for general covariate designs; covariates may be continuous as well as discrete and may be correlated. The test is asymptotically valid when the errors are not exchangeable, in particular in the presence of conditional heteroskedasticity.

abstract: This paper illustrates and addresses weak identification in the correlated random coefficient (CRC) model that Suri (2011) uses to study agricultural technology adoption. Using the publicly available data set, which differs slightly from the version used in Suri (2011), we obtain different point estimates for the paper's main CRC model. To understand why these differences are as large as they are, we recast the CRC model as a more general random coefficient model in which the returns to hybrid adoption are restricted to be linear in comparative advantage. This reveals that the key structural parameter in the CRC model ( ϕ ), which governs the relationship between baseline productivity and the returns to adoption, is prone to a weak‐identification problem. We then propose a procedure to conduct weak‐identification robust inference on ϕ using test inversion. Our weak‐identification robust confidence intervals contain the original Suri (2011) point estimates, which suggests that the difference in results may be attributable to a combination of minor data differences and weak identification.
abstract_zh: 本文阐述并探讨了Suri(2011)用于研究农业技术采纳的相关随机系数(CRC)模型中的弱识别问题。利用公开可获取的数据集(该数据集与Suri(2011)所用版本略有差异)，我们得到了该文主要CRC模型的不同点估计值。为理解这些差异为何如此之大，我们将CRC模型重构为一个更一般的随机系数模型，其中杂交品种采纳的收益被限定为比较优势的线性函数。这揭示出CRC模型中的关键结构参数(ϕ)——它决定了基准生产率与采纳收益之间的关系——容易出现弱识别问题。随后，我们提出了一种利用检验反演对ϕ进行弱识别稳健推断的程序。我们的弱识别稳健置信区间包含了Suri(2011)的原始点估计值，这表明结果的差异可能归因于细微的数据差异与弱识别的共同作用。

Comment on

abstract: Standard optimal capital tax theory abstracts from modeling asset prices, making it unsuitable for thinking about capital gains and wealth taxation. We study optimal redistributive taxation in an environment with asset‐price movements, adopting the modern finance view that asset prices fluctuate not only because of changing cash flows, but also due to other factors (“discount rates”). We show that a combination of realization‐based capital gains and cash flow taxes implements the optimal allocation regardless of the source of asset‐price fluctuations. Moreover, the capital gains tax avoids distortions in portfolio choice (the so‐called lock‐in effect) by targeting total net trades rather than gains from selling individual assets. These results stand in contrast to the classic Haig–Simons comprehensive income tax concept as well as recent proposals for wealth or accrual‐based capital gains taxes.
abstract_zh: 标准最优资本税理论抽象掉了资产价格的建模，因而无法适用于思考资本利得税与财富税。我们在一个存在资产价格变动的环境中研究最优再分配税收，采纳现代金融的观点，即资产价格的波动不仅源于现金流的变化，也源于其他因素（“贴现率”）。我们表明，基于实现原则的资本利得税与现金流税的组合，无论资产价格波动的来源如何，都能实现最优配置。此外，资本利得税通过针对总净交易而非出售单项资产的利得，避免了对投资组合选择的扭曲（即所谓的锁定效应）。这些结果与经典的Haig–Simons综合所得税概念以及近期关于财富税或基于权责发生制的资本利得税的建议形成鲜明对比。
title: Putting the ‘Finance’ Into ‘Public Finance’: A Theory of Capital Gains Taxation
title_zh: 将“金融”融入“公共财政”：资本利得税理论

abstract: I develop a new method for estimating production functions with labor‐augmenting technology and apply it to markup estimation. The method imposes limited parametric restrictions and generalizes prior approaches that rely on the CES production function. I first extend the canonical Olley–Pakes framework assumptions to multidimensional productivity and then develop an identification strategy based on a control variable approach and first‐order conditions. I use this method to estimate output elasticities and markups in manufacturing industries in the US and four developing countries. I find that neglecting labor‐augmenting productivity underestimates capital elasticity, overestimates variable input elasticity, and overestimates markups in all countries.
abstract_zh: 我提出一种新方法，用于估计包含劳动增强型技术的生产函数，并将其应用于加成率估计。该方法施加有限的参数限制，并推广了先前依赖CES生产函数的方法。我首先将经典的Olley–Pakes框架假设扩展到多维生产率，然后基于控制变量方法和一阶条件开发一种识别策略。我使用该方法估计美国和四个发展中国家制造业的产出弹性和加成率。我发现，忽视劳动增强型生产率会低估资本弹性、高估可变投入弹性，并在所有国家高估加成率。
title: Production Function Estimation With Factor‐Augmenting Technology: An Application to Markups
title_zh: 使用要素增强型技术的生产函数估计：在加成率中的应用

abstract: This paper investigates concerns that vertically integrated platforms like Amazon steer demand toward their own offers via algorithmic prominence, potentially harming consumers. On Amazon, for each product, the Buybox prominence algorithm selects one seller to feature, influencing which offers consumers consider. Using novel Amazon sales and Buybox (prominence) data, we estimate a structural model capturing the effects of such algorithmic prominence on consumer choices, seller pricing, and entry. We find that the platform can indeed steer demand as 95% of consumers consider only the Buybox offer. The Buybox is highly price‐elastic (−21), but skews toward Amazon's own offers, which are featured as frequently as observably similar offers priced 5% cheaper. Still, as consumers prefer these offers, this skew does not amount to self‐preferencing in the sense of harming consumers: consumer surplus is roughly maximized at the estimated Amazon Buybox advantage, which balances higher prices against showing consumers their preferred offers.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了纵向一体化平台（如亚马逊）通过算法突出展示将需求导向自身报价、可能损害消费者的担忧。在亚马逊上，针对每件商品，Buybox突出展示算法会选择一位卖家进行展示，从而影响消费者考虑哪些报价。利用新颖的亚马逊销售与Buybox（突出展示）数据，我们估计了一个结构模型，以刻画此类算法突出展示对消费者选择、卖家定价和进入的影响。我们发现，平台确实能够引导需求，因为95%的消费者仅考虑Buybox报价。Buybox具有很高的价格弹性（−21），但偏向于亚马逊自身的报价，这些报价被展示的频率与可观测相似但价格低5%的报价相同。尽管如此，由于消费者偏好这些报价，这种偏向并不构成损害消费者意义上的自我优待：消费者剩余在估计的亚马逊Buybox优势处大致实现最大化，该优势在较高价格与向消费者展示其更偏好的报价之间取得平衡。
title: Two‐Sided Markets Shaped by Platform‐Guided Search
title_zh: 平台引导搜索塑造的双边市场

abstract: This paper develops an endogenous growth model of decarbonization in which heterogeneous knowledge creation drives both economic growth and energy transition dynamics. The framework integrates clean and dirty energy technologies in a unified macroeconomic setting with aggregate and sector-specific knowledge accumulation, as well as explicit (investment-driven) and tacit (learning-based) knowledge creation. These mechanisms jointly determine innovation incentives, factor allocation, and technological change. A central feature is an endogenous technology tipping point: clean energy becomes self-reinforcing once expected innovation returns exceed those of fossil technologies, inducing a reallocation of mobile inputs toward clean innovation and accelerating structural change. The position of this threshold depends on knowledge diffusion across sectors and on climate policy. The model yields three results. First, it provides closed-form solutions for consumption and transition dynamics over the full decarbonization path, showing that transitional consumption costs of climate policy are substantially smaller than commonly perceived due to endogenous innovation responses. Second, it characterizes conditions for technology tipping in an economy with heterogeneous and partially diffusing knowledge stocks, and shows that tipping can occur at relatively low clean-energy market shares compared to standard directed technical change models. Third, it demonstrates that carbon taxes and clean-energy subsidies have symmetric effects on the tipping condition, while differing in transitional dynamics and emissions paths. Overall, the analysis highlights how knowledge structure shapes growth and decarbonization, and how policy can shift the economy toward a clean growth regime.
title: Decarbonization with heterogeneous knowledge creation and technology tipping

abstract: We consider a seller who is facing loss-averse buyers over two periods, with an uncertain price in the second period. We incorporate the decision to adopt a most-favored-customer (MFC) clause into the seller’s problem, and solve for the optimal price and the optimal MFC decision. We show that the seller optimally adopts MFC if and only if the buyers are sufficiently loss averse. Also, for sufficiently patient buyers, the seller optimally adopts MFC if and only if the buyers are loss averse. Moreover, under some mild conditions, MFC enhances welfare whenever buyers are sufficiently loss averse.
title: Best-Price Provision under Loss Aversion

abstract: This paper studies a two-stage model of experimentation, where the researcher first samples representative experimental participants from an eligible pool, then assigns each sampled unit to treatment or control, using matched k-tuples randomization at both stages.
title: Fine Stratification of Survey Experiments

abstract: We analyze a game-theoretic model of crime and crime reporting to study the quality of crime statistics. An offender potentially engages in illicit behavior; an enforcer chooses effort and how to report outcomes. Because of signaling concerns, the enforcer may misreport. We show that multiple equilibria can exist and characterize when crime is under- or overreported.
title: Juking the Stats: Policing, Misreporting, and Policy Evaluation

abstract: Monetary policy is typically understood to affect employment through labor demand, with the role of labor supply receiving less consideration. We estimate the response of labor market flows to high-frequency changes in interest rates around FOMC announcements and Fed Chair speeches, and find that a contractionary monetary policy shock leads to a significant increase in labor supply: workers reduce the rate at which they quit jobs to nonemployment, and non-employed individuals increase their job-seeking behavior.
title: The Labor Demand and Labor Supply Channels of Monetary Policy
